Theorem
[Sharafutdinov retraction, submetry, and soul rigidity]

Source: petersen:page-0482 ↗ thm:pet-ch12-soul-theorem 1. ch12:12.4.9Let $S$ be a soul of a complete Riemannian manifold with $\sec \ge 0$, arising from the construction of section 4.

  1. (Sharafutdinov) There is a distance-nonincreasing map $\mathrm{Sh}:M\to S$ with $\mathrm{Sh}|_S=\mathrm{id}$; in particular all souls of $M$ are isometric to each other.

  2. (Perel’man) $\mathrm{Sh}$ is a submetry; consequently $S$ is a point whenever all sectional curvatures based at some single point of $M$ are positive.
